acceptance: Inbox intake warns (shadow) and later refuses (enforce, operator flip) an item that declares a whole hub directory (go/cmd/evolve, go/internal/core) in files when it could name the files it changes.
The warning names the hub and suggests the verb file family.
A test files an item with files [go/cmd/evolve] and sees the typed warning; one with named files sees none.
fix: Make hub items name their files at intake, so file-grain admission can run them in parallel.
summary: File-grain admission for cmd/evolve is on (K1), but 14 of 60 lane-routable cmd/evolve items declare the whole directory, so they still hold the package cell and block parallel lanes. Measured would-admit pairs: package 0, declared file set 1016 of 1770.
title: Items that touch a hub package name their files at intake
